title: Toddler Running on Sunny Deck Balcony, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful toddler bundled in an overcoat and sturdy walking shoes happily toddles across an elevated wooden deck or balcony. The railing is enclosed with protective wire mesh netting against the bright sun, casting distinct crisscrossing shadows across the boardwalk. A house exterior with wooden siding frames the left side of the scene.
